## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Data

```{r}
penguins
```



## First example

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins, 
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "My great informative title",
    x = "Flipper Length (mm)"
  )
```
